policies.text: An item qualified for green status that features a warranty duration of 8 years or longer gains eligibility for commercial rebates.
A unit achieves quiet operational clearance if its acoustic output does not exceed 50 dB.
A device secures industrial heavy-duty classification when it possesses a dust resistance rating of 5 or higher.
Agricultural machinery receives high-yield energy certification provided its power factor exceeds 0.95.
Equipment attains premium green status either with an IP67 waterproof certification alongside an efficiency rating of at least 20 percent, or by securing a TUV Rheinland Excellence Seal.
